title: He Made $1 Billion in One Day. Legally. #shorts
description:
On Black Wednesday, September sixteenth, nineteen ninety-two, one hedge fund bet against the British pound and beat the Bank of England.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.

lines.text: One man made a billion dollars in a single day. Legally.
His opponent? The Bank of England.
In nineteen ninety-two, Britain swore it would defend the pound at any price.
George Soros was sure the pound was too strong.
So his fund bet about ten billion dollars against it.
On one Wednesday, Britain raised interest rates twice in a single day.
It didn't work. Everyone kept selling.
That night, Britain gave up and let the pound fall.
His fund walked away with about one billion dollars.
One day, one bet, and he became the man who broke the Bank of England.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
